1.zh: 奉　神旨意作基督耶稣使徒的保罗和兄弟提摩太，写信给在哥林多　神的教会，并亚该亚遍处的众圣徒。
1.en: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, and Timothy our brother, to the assembly of God which is at Corinth, with all the saints who are in the whole of Achaia:

1.zh: 愿恩惠、平安从　神我们的父和主耶稣基督归与你们！
1.en: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

1.zh: 愿颂赞归与我们的主耶稣基督的父　神，就是发慈悲的父，赐各样安慰的　神。
1.en: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies and God of all comfort,

1.zh: 我们在一切患难中，他就安慰我们，叫我们能用　神所赐的安慰去安慰那遭各样患难的人。
1.en: who comforts us in all our affliction, that we may be able to comfort those who are in any affliction, through the comfort with which we ourselves are comforted by God.

1.zh: 我们既多受基督的苦楚，就靠基督多得安慰。
1.en: For as the sufferings of Christ abound to us, even so our comfort also abounds through Christ.

1.zh: 我们受患难呢，是为叫你们得安慰，得拯救；我们得安慰呢，也是为叫你们得安慰；这安慰能叫你们忍受我们所受的那样苦楚。
1.en: But if we are afflicted, it is for your comfort and salvation. If we are comforted, it is for your comfort, which produces in you the patient enduring of the same sufferings which we also suffer.

1.zh: 我们为你们所存的盼望是确定的，因为知道你们既是同受苦楚，也必同得安慰。
1.en: Our hope for you is steadfast, knowing that, since you are partakers of the sufferings, so you are also of the comfort.

1.zh: 弟兄们，我们不要你们不晓得，我们从前在亚细亚遭遇苦难，被压太重，力不能胜，甚至连活命的指望都绝了；
1.en: For we don’t desire to have you uninformed, brothers, concerning our affliction which happened to us in Asia: that we were weighed down exceedingly, beyond our power, so much that we despaired even of life.

1.zh: 自己心里也断定是必死的，叫我们不靠自己，只靠叫死人复活的　神。
1.en: Yes, we ourselves have had the sentence of death within ourselves, that we should not trust in ourselves, but in God who raises the dead,

1.zh: 他曾救我们脱离那极大的死亡，现在仍要救我们，并且我们指望他将来还要救我们。
1.en: who delivered us out of so great a death, and does deliver, on whom we have set our hope that he will also still deliver us,

1.zh: 你们以祈祷帮助我们，好叫许多人为我们谢恩，就是为我们因许多人所得的恩。
1.en: you also helping together on our behalf by your supplication; that, for the gift given to us by means of many, thanks may be given by many persons on your behalf.

1.zh: 我们所夸的是自己的良心，见证我们凭着　神的圣洁和诚实；在世为人不靠人的聪明，乃靠　神的恩惠，向你们更是这样。
1.en: For our boasting is this: the testimony of our conscience that in holiness and sincerity of God, not in fleshly wisdom but in the grace of God, we behaved ourselves in the world, and more abundantly toward you.

1.zh: 我们现在写给你们的话，并不外乎你们所念的、所认识的，我也盼望你们到底还是要认识；
1.en: For we write no other things to you than what you read or even acknowledge, and I hope you will acknowledge to the end—

1.zh: 正如你们已经有几分认识我们，以我们夸口，好像我们在我们主耶稣的日子以你们夸口一样。
1.en: as also you acknowledged us in part—that we are your boasting, even as you also are ours, in the day of our Lord Jesus.

1.zh: 我既然这样深信，就早有意到你们那里去，叫你们再得益处；
1.en: In this confidence, I was determined to come first to you, that you might have a second benefit,

1.zh: 也要从你们那里经过，往马其顿去，再从马其顿回到你们那里，叫你们给我送行往犹太去。
1.en: and by you to pass into Macedonia, and again from Macedonia to come to you, and to be sent forward by you on my journey to Judea.

1.zh: 我有此意，岂是反复不定吗？我所起的意，岂是从情欲起的，叫我忽是忽非吗？
1.en: When I therefore planned this, did I show fickleness? Or the things that I plan, do I plan according to the flesh, that with me there should be the “Yes, yes” and the “No, no?”

1.zh: 我指着信实的　神说，我们向你们所传的道，并没有是而又非的。
1.en: But as God is faithful, our word toward you was not “Yes and no.”

1.zh: 因为我和西拉并提摩太，在你们中间所传　神的儿子耶稣基督，总没有是而又非的，在他只有一是。
1.en: For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, who was preached among you by us—by me, Silvanus, and Timothy—was not “Yes and no,” but in him is “Yes.”

1.zh: 神的应许，不论有多少，在基督都是是的。所以借着他也都是实在的，叫　神因我们得荣耀。
1.en: For however many are the promises of God, in him is the “Yes.” Therefore also through him is the “Amen”, to the glory of God through us.

1.zh: 那在基督里坚固我们和你们，并且膏我们的就是　神。
1.en: Now he who establishes us with you in Christ and anointed us is God,

1.zh: 他又用印印了我们，并赐[圣]灵在我们心里作凭据。
1.en: who also sealed us and gave us the down payment of the Spirit in our hearts.

1.zh: 我呼吁　神给我的心作见证，我没有往哥林多去是为要宽容你们。
1.en: But I call God for a witness to my soul, that to spare you, I didn’t come to Corinth.

1.zh: 我们并不是辖管你们的信心，乃是帮助你们的快乐，因为你们凭信才站立得住。
1.en: We don’t control your faith, but are fellow workers with you for your joy. For you stand firm in faith.

2.zh: 我自己定了主意再到你们那里去，必须大家没有忧愁。
2.en: But I determined this for myself, that I would not come to you again in sorrow.

2.zh: 倘若我叫你们忧愁，除了我叫那忧愁的人以外，谁能叫我快乐呢？
2.en: For if I make you grieve, then who will make me glad but he who is made to grieve by me?

2.zh: 我曾把这事写给你们，恐怕我到的时候，应该叫我快乐的那些人，反倒叫我忧愁。我也深信，你们众人都以我的快乐为自己的快乐。
2.en: And I wrote this very thing to you, so that when I came, I wouldn’t have sorrow from them of whom I ought to rejoice; having confidence in you all that my joy would be shared by all of you.

2.zh: 我先前心里难过痛苦，多多地流泪，写信给你们，不是叫你们忧愁，乃是叫你们知道我格外地疼爱你们。
2.en: For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote to you with many tears, not that you should be made to grieve, but that you might know the love that I have so abundantly for you.

2.zh: 若有叫人忧愁的，他不但叫我忧愁，也是叫你们众人有几分忧愁。我说几分，恐怕说得太重。
2.en: But if any has caused sorrow, he has caused sorrow not to me, but in part (that I not press too heavily) to you all.

2.zh: 这样的人受了众人的责罚也就够了，
2.en: This punishment which was inflicted by the many is sufficient for such a one;

2.zh: 倒不如赦免他，安慰他，免得他忧愁太过，甚至沉沦了。
2.en: so that, on the contrary, you should rather forgive him and comfort him, lest by any means such a one should be swallowed up with his excessive sorrow.

2.zh: 所以我劝你们，要向他显出坚定不移的爱心来。
2.en: Therefore I beg you to confirm your love toward him.

2.zh: 为此我先前也写信给你们，要试验你们，看你们凡事顺从不顺从。
2.en: For to this end I also wrote, that I might know the proof of you, whether you are obedient in all things.

2.zh: 你们赦免谁，我也赦免谁。我若有所赦免的，是在基督面前为你们赦免的，
2.en: Now I also forgive whomever you forgive anything. For if indeed I have forgiven anything, I have forgiven that one for your sakes in the presence of Christ,

2.zh: 免得撒但趁着机会胜过我们，因我们并非不晓得他的诡计。
2.en: that no advantage may be gained over us by Satan, for we are not ignorant of his schemes.

2.zh: 我从前为基督的福音到了特罗亚，主也给我开了门。
2.en: Now when I came to Troas for the Good News of Christ, and when a door was opened to me in the Lord,

2.zh: 那时，因为没有遇见兄弟提多，我心里不安，便辞别那里的人往马其顿去了。
2.en: I had no relief for my spirit, because I didn’t find Titus my brother, but taking my leave of them, I went out into Macedonia.

2.zh: 感谢　神！常率领我们在基督里夸胜，并借着我们在各处显扬那因认识基督而有的香气。
2.en: Now thanks be to God who always leads us in triumph in Christ, and reveals through us the sweet aroma of his knowledge in every place.

2.zh: 因为我们在　神面前，无论在得救的人身上或灭亡的人身上，都有基督馨香之气。
2.en: For we are a sweet aroma of Christ to God in those who are being saved and in those who perish:

2.zh: 在这等人，就作了死的香气叫他死；在那等人，就作了活的香气叫他活。这事谁能当得起呢？
2.en: to the one a stench from death to death, to the other a sweet aroma from life to life. Who is sufficient for these things?

2.zh: 我们不像那许多人，为利混乱　神的道；乃是由于诚实，由于　神，在　神面前凭着基督讲道。
2.en: For we are not as so many, peddling the word of God. But as of sincerity, but as of God, in the sight of God, we speak in Christ.

3.zh: 我们岂是又举荐自己吗？岂像别人用人的荐信给你们或用你们的荐信给人吗？
3.en: Are we beginning again to commend ourselves? Or do we need, as do some, letters of commendation to you or from you?

3.zh: 你们就是我们的荐信，写在我们的心里，被众人所知道所念诵的。
3.en: You are our letter, written in our hearts, known and read by all men,

3.zh: 你们明显是基督的信，借着我们修成的。不是用墨写的，乃是用永生　神的灵写的；不是写在石版上，乃是写在心版上。
3.en: being revealed that you are a letter of Christ, served by us, written not with ink, but with the Spirit of the living God; not in tablets of stone, but in tablets that are hearts of flesh.

3.zh: 我们因基督，所以在　神面前才有这样的信心。
3.en: Such confidence we have through Christ toward God,

3.zh: 并不是我们凭自己能承担什么事；我们所能承担的，乃是出于　神。
3.en: not that we are sufficient of ourselves to account anything as from ourselves; but our sufficiency is from God,

3.zh: 他叫我们能承当这新约的执事，不是凭着字句，乃是凭着精意；因为那字句是叫人死，精意是叫人活。
3.en: who also made us sufficient as servants of a new covenant, not of the letter but of the Spirit. For the letter kills, but the Spirit gives life.

3.zh: 那用字刻在石头上属死的职事尚且有荣光，甚至以色列人因摩西面上的荣光，不能定睛看他的脸；这荣光原是渐渐退去的，
3.en: But if the service of death, written engraved on stones, came with glory, so that the children of Israel could not look steadfastly on the face of Moses for the glory of his face, which was passing away,

3.zh: 何况那属灵的职事岂不更有荣光吗？
3.en: won’t service of the Spirit be with much more glory?

3.zh: 若是定罪的职事有荣光，那称义的职事荣光就越发大了。
3.en: For if the service of condemnation has glory, the service of righteousness exceeds much more in glory.

3.zh: 那从前有荣光的，因这极大的荣光就算不得有荣光了；
3.en: For most certainly that which has been made glorious has not been made glorious in this respect, by reason of the glory that surpasses.

3.zh: 若那废掉的有荣光，这长存的就更有荣光了。
3.en: For if that which passes away was with glory, much more that which remains is in glory.

3.zh: 我们既有这样的盼望，就大胆讲说，
3.en: Having therefore such a hope, we use great boldness of speech,

3.zh: 不像摩西将帕子蒙在脸上，叫以色列人不能定睛看到那将废者[的]结局。
3.en: and not as Moses, who put a veil on his face so that the children of Israel wouldn’t look steadfastly on the end of that which was passing away.

3.zh: 但他们的心地刚硬，直到今日诵读旧约的时候，这帕子还没有揭去。这帕子在基督里已经废去了。
3.en: But their minds were hardened, for until this very day at the reading of the old covenant the same veil remains, because in Christ it passes away.

3.zh: 然而直到今日，每逢诵读摩西[书]的时候，帕子还在他们心上。
3.en: But to this day, when Moses is read, a veil lies on their heart.

3.zh: 但他们的心几时归向主，帕子就几时除去了。
3.en: But whenever someone turns to the Lord, the veil is taken away.

3.zh: 主就是那灵；主的灵在哪里，那里就得以自由。
3.en: Now the Lord is the Spirit; and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is liberty.

3.zh: 我们众人既然敞着脸得以看见主的荣光，好像从镜子里返照，就变成主的形状，荣上加荣，如同从主的灵变成的。
3.en: But we all, with unveiled face seeing the glory of the Lord as in a mirror, are transformed into the same image from glory to glory, even as from the Lord, the Spirit.

4.zh: 我们既然蒙怜悯，受了这职分，就不丧胆，
4.en: Therefore, seeing we have this ministry, even as we obtained mercy, we don’t faint.

4.zh: 乃将那些暗昧可耻的事弃绝了；不行诡诈，不谬讲　神的道理，只将真理表明出来，好在　神面前把自己荐与各人的良心。
4.en: But we have renounced the hidden things of shame, not walking in craftiness nor handling the word of God deceitfully, but by the manifestation of the truth commending ourselves to every man’s conscience in the sight of God.

4.zh: 如果我们的福音蒙蔽，就是蒙蔽在灭亡的人身上。
4.en: Even if our Good News is veiled, it is veiled in those who are dying,

4.zh: 此等不信之人被这世界的神弄瞎了心眼，不叫基督荣耀福音的光照着他们。基督本是　神的像。
4.en: in whom the god of this world has blinded the minds of the unbelieving, that the light of the Good News of the glory of Christ, who is the image of God, should not dawn on them.

4.zh: 我们原不是传自己，乃是传基督耶稣为主，并且自己因耶稣作你们的仆人。
4.en: For we don’t preach ourselves, but Christ Jesus as Lord, and ourselves as your servants for Jesus’ sake,

4.zh: 那吩咐光从黑暗里照出来的　神，已经照在我们心里，叫我们得知　神荣耀的光显在耶稣基督的面上。
4.en: seeing it is God who said, “Light will shine out of darkness,” who has shone in our hearts to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.

4.zh: 我们有这宝贝放在瓦器里，要显明这莫大的能力是出于　神，不是出于我们。
4.en: But we have this treasure in clay vessels, that the exceeding greatness of the power may be of God and not from ourselves.

4.zh: 我们四面受敌，却不被困住；心里作难，却不至失望；
4.en: We are pressed on every side, yet not crushed; perplexed, yet not to despair;

4.zh: 遭逼迫，却不被丢弃；打倒了，却不至死亡。
4.en: pursued, yet not forsaken; struck down, yet not destroyed;

4.zh: 身上常带着耶稣的死，使耶稣的生也显明在我们身上。
4.en: always carrying in the body the putting to death of the Lord Jesus, that the life of Jesus may also be revealed in our body.

4.zh: 因为我们这活着的人是常为耶稣被交于死地，使耶稣的生在我们这必死的身上显明出来。
4.en: For we who live are always delivered to death for Jesus’ sake, that the life also of Jesus may be revealed in our mortal flesh.

4.zh: 这样看来，死是在我们身上发动，生却在你们身上发动。
4.en: So then death works in us, but life in you.

4.zh: 但我们既有信心，正如[经上]记着说：「我因信，所以如此说话。」我们也信，所以也说话。
4.en: But having the same spirit of faith, according to that which is written, “I believed, and therefore I spoke.” We also believe, and therefore we also speak,

4.zh: 自己知道那叫主耶稣复活的，也必叫我们与耶稣一同复活，并且叫我们与你们一同站在他面前。
4.en: knowing that he who raised the Lord Jesus will raise us also through Jesus, and will present us with you.

4.zh: 凡事都是为你们，好叫恩惠因人多越发加增，感谢格外显多，以致荣耀归与　神。
4.en: For all things are for your sakes, that the grace, being multiplied through the many, may cause the thanksgiving to abound to the glory of God.

4.zh: 所以，我们不丧胆。外体虽然毁坏，内心却一天新似一天。
4.en: Therefore we don’t faint, but though our outward person is decaying, yet our inward person is renewed day by day.

4.zh: 我们这至暂至轻的苦楚，要为我们成就极重无比、永远的荣耀。
4.en: For our light affliction, which is for the moment, works for us more and more exceedingly an eternal weight of glory,

4.zh: 原来我们不是顾念所见的，乃是顾念所不见的；因为所见的是暂时的，所不见的是永远的。
4.en: while we don’t look at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen. For the things which are seen are temporal, but the things which are not seen are eternal.

5.zh: 我们原知道，我们这地上的帐棚若拆毁了，必得　神所造，不是人手所造，在天上永存的房屋。
5.en: For we know that if the earthly house of our tent is dissolved, we have a building from God, a house not made with hands, eternal, in the heavens.

5.zh: 我们在这帐棚里叹息，深想得那从天上来的房屋，好像穿上[衣服]；
5.en: For most certainly in this we groan, longing to be clothed with our habitation which is from heaven,

5.zh: 倘若穿上，被遇见的时候就不至于赤身了。
5.en: if indeed being clothed, we will not be found naked.

5.zh: 我们在这帐棚里叹息劳苦，并非愿意脱下这个，乃是愿意穿上那个，好叫这必死的被生命吞灭了。
5.en: For indeed we who are in this tent do groan, being burdened, not that we desire to be unclothed, but that we desire to be clothed, that what is mortal may be swallowed up by life.

5.zh: 为此，培植我们的就是　神，他又赐给我们[圣]灵作凭据。
5.en: Now he who made us for this very thing is God, who also gave to us the down payment of the Spirit.

5.zh: 所以，我们时常坦然无惧，并且晓得我们住在身内，便与主相离。
5.en: Therefore we are always confident and know that while we are at home in the body, we are absent from the Lord;

5.zh: 因我们行事为人是凭着信心，不是凭着眼见。
5.en: for we walk by faith, not by sight.

5.zh: 我们坦然无惧，是更愿意离开身体与主同住。
5.en: We are courageous, I say, and are willing rather to be absent from the body and to be at home with the Lord.

5.zh: 所以，无论是住在身内，离开身外，我们立了志向，要得主的喜悦。
5.en: Therefore also we make it our aim, whether at home or absent, to be well pleasing to him.

5.zh: 因为我们众人必要在基督台前显露出来，叫各人按着本身所行的，或善或恶受报。
5.en: For we must all be revealed before the judgment seat of Christ that each one may receive the things in the body according to what he has done, whether good or bad.

5.zh: 我们既知道主是可畏的，所以劝人。但我们在　神面前是显明的，盼望在你们的良心里也是显明的。
5.en: Knowing therefore the fear of the Lord, we persuade men, but we are revealed to God, and I hope that we are revealed also in your consciences.

5.zh: 我们不是向你们再举荐自己，乃是叫你们因我们有可夸之处，好对那凭外貌不凭内心夸口的人，有言可答。
5.en: For we are not commending ourselves to you again, but speak as giving you occasion of boasting on our behalf, that you may have something to answer those who boast in appearance and not in heart.

5.zh: 我们若果颠狂，是为　神；若果谨守，是为你们。
5.en: For if we are beside ourselves, it is for God. Or if we are of sober mind, it is for you.

5.zh: 原来基督的爱激励我们；因我们想，一人既替众人死，众人就都死了；
5.en: For the love of Christ compels us; because we judge thus: that one died for all, therefore all died.

5.zh: 并且他替众人死，是叫那些活着的人不再为自己活，乃为替他们死而复活的[主]活。
5.en: He died for all, that those who live should no longer live to themselves, but to him who for their sakes died and rose again.

5.zh: 所以，我们从今以后，不凭着外貌认人了。虽然凭着外貌认过基督，如今却不再[这样]认他了。
5.en: Therefore we know no one according to the flesh from now on. Even though we have known Christ according to the flesh, yet now we know him so no more.

5.zh: 若有人在基督里，他就是新造的人，旧事已过，都变成新的了。
5.en: Therefore if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation. The old things have passed away. Behold, all things have become new.

5.zh: 一切都是出于　神；他借着基督使我们与他和好，又将劝人与他和好的职分赐给我们。
5.en: But all things are of God, who reconciled us to himself through Jesus Christ, and gave to us the ministry of reconciliation;

5.zh: 这就是　神在基督里，叫世人与自己和好，不将他们的过犯归到他们身上，并且将这和好的道理托付了我们。
5.en: namely, that God was in Christ reconciling the world to himself, not reckoning to them their trespasses, and having committed to us the word of reconciliation.

5.zh: 所以，我们作基督的使者，就好像　神借我们劝你们一般。我们替基督求你们与　神和好。
5.en: We are therefore ambassadors on behalf of Christ, as though God were entreating by us: we beg you on behalf of Christ, be reconciled to God.

5.zh: 神使那无罪的，替我们成为罪，好叫我们在他里面成为　神的义。
5.en: For him who knew no sin he made to be sin on our behalf, so that in him we might become the righteousness of God.

6.zh: 我们与　[神]同工的，也劝你们不可徒受他的恩典。
6.en: Working together, we entreat also that you do not receive the grace of God in vain.

6.zh: 因为他说：「在悦纳的时候，我应允了你；在拯救的日子，我搭救了你。」看哪，现在正是悦纳的时候！现在正是拯救的日子；
6.en: For he says, “At an acceptable time I listened to you. In a day of salvation I helped you.” Behold, now is the acceptable time. Behold, now is the day of salvation.

6.zh: 我们凡事都不叫人有妨碍，免得这职分被人毁谤；
6.en: We give no occasion of stumbling in anything, that our service may not be blamed,

6.zh: 反倒在各样的事上表明自己是　神的用人，就如在许多的忍耐、患难、穷乏、困苦、
6.en: but in everything commending ourselves as servants of God: in great endurance, in afflictions, in hardships, in distresses,

6.zh: 鞭打、监禁、扰乱、勤劳、警醒、不食、
6.en: in beatings, in imprisonments, in riots, in labors, in watchings, in fastings,

6.zh: 廉洁、知识、恒忍、恩慈、圣灵的感化、无伪的爱心、
6.en: in pureness, in knowledge, in perseverance, in kindness, in the Holy Spirit, in sincere love,

6.zh: 真实的道理、　神的大能；仁义的兵器在左在右；
6.en: in the word of truth, in the power of God, by the armor of righteousness on the right hand and on the left,

6.zh: 荣耀、羞辱，恶名、美名；似乎是诱惑人的，却是诚实的；
6.en: by glory and dishonor, by evil report and good report, as deceivers and yet true,

6.zh: 似乎不为人所知，却是人所共知的；似乎要死，却是活着的；似乎受责罚，却是不至丧命的；
6.en: as unknown and yet well known, as dying and behold—we live, as punished and not killed,

6.zh: 似乎忧愁，却是常常快乐的；似乎贫穷，却是叫许多人富足的；似乎一无所有，却是样样都有的。
6.en: as sorrowful yet always rejoicing, as poor yet making many rich, as having nothing and yet possessing all things.

6.zh: 哥林多人哪，我们向你们，口是张开的，心是宽宏的。
6.en: Our mouth is open to you, Corinthians. Our heart is enlarged.

6.zh: 你们狭窄，原不在乎我们，是在乎自己的心肠狭窄。
6.en: You are not restricted by us, but you are restricted by your own affections.

6.zh: 你们也要照样用宽宏的心报答我。我这话正像对自己的孩子说的。
6.en: Now in return—I speak as to my children—you also open your hearts.

6.zh: 你们和不信的原不相配，不要同负一轭。义和不义有什么相交呢？光明和黑暗有什么相通呢？
6.en: Don’t be unequally yoked with unbelievers, for what fellowship do righteousness and iniquity have? Or what fellowship does light have with darkness?

6.zh: 基督和彼列有什么相和呢？信[主]的和不信[主]的有什么相干呢？
6.en: What agreement does Christ have with Belial? Or what portion does a believer have with an unbeliever?

6.zh: 神的殿和偶像有什么相同呢？因为我们是永生　神的殿，就如　神曾说： 我要在他们中间居住， 在他们中间来往； 我要作他们的　神； 他们要作我的子民。
6.en: What agreement does a temple of God have with idols? For you are a temple of the living God. Even as God said, “I will dwell in them and walk in them. I will be their God and they will be my people.”

6.zh: 又说：你们务要从他们中间出来， 与他们分别； 不要沾不洁净的物，我就收纳你们。
6.en: Therefore “‘Come out from among them, and be separate,’ says the Lord. ‘Touch no unclean thing. I will receive you.

6.zh: 我要作你们的父； 你们要作我的儿女。 这是全能的主说的。
6.en: I will be to you a Father. You will be to me sons and daughters,’ says the Lord Almighty.”

7.zh: 亲爱的[弟兄]啊，我们既有这等应许，就当洁净自己，除去身体、灵魂一切的污秽，敬畏　神，得以成圣。
7.en: Having therefore these promises, beloved, let’s cleanse ourselves from all defilement of flesh and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God.

7.zh: 你们要心地宽大收纳我们。我们未曾亏负谁，未曾败坏谁，未曾占谁的便宜。
7.en: Open your hearts to us. We wronged no one. We corrupted no one. We took advantage of no one.

7.zh: 我说这话，不是要定你们的罪。我已经说过，你们常在我们心里，情愿与你们同生同死。
7.en: I say this not to condemn you, for I have said before that you are in our hearts to die together and live together.

7.zh: 我大大地放胆，向你们说话；我因你们多多夸口，满得安慰；我们在一切患难中分外的快乐。
7.en: Great is my boldness of speech toward you. Great is my boasting on your behalf. I am filled with comfort. I overflow with joy in all our affliction.

7.zh: 我们从前就是到了马其顿的时候，身体也不得安宁，周围遭患难，外有争战，内有惧怕。
7.en: For even when we had come into Macedonia, our flesh had no relief, but we were afflicted on every side. Fightings were outside. Fear was inside.

7.zh: 但那安慰丧气之人的　神借着提多来安慰了我们；
7.en: Nevertheless, he who comforts the lowly, God, comforted us by the coming of Titus,

7.zh: 不但借着他来，也借着他从你们所得的安慰，安慰了我们；因他把你们的想念、哀恸，和向我的热心，都告诉了我，叫我更加欢喜。
7.en: and not by his coming only, but also by the comfort with which he was comforted in you while he told us of your longing, your mourning, and your zeal for me, so that I rejoiced still more.

7.zh: 我先前写信叫你们忧愁，我后来虽然懊悔，如今却不懊悔；因我知道，那信叫你们忧愁不过是暂时的。
7.en: For though I grieved you with my letter, I do not regret it, though I did regret it. For I see that my letter made you grieve, though just for a while.

7.zh: 如今我欢喜，不是因你们忧愁，是因你们从忧愁中生出懊悔来。你们依着　神的意思忧愁，凡事就不至于因我们受亏损了。
7.en: I now rejoice, not that you were grieved, but that you were grieved to repentance. For you were grieved in a godly way, that you might suffer loss by us in nothing.

7.zh: 因为依着　神的意思忧愁，就生出没有后悔的懊悔来，以致得救；但世俗的忧愁是叫人死。
7.en: For godly sorrow produces repentance leading to salvation, which brings no regret. But the sorrow of the world produces death.

7.zh: 你看，你们依着　神的意思忧愁，从此就生出何等的殷勤、自诉、自恨、恐惧、想念、热心、责罚。在这一切事上，你们都表明自己是洁净的。
7.en: For behold, this same thing, that you were grieved in a godly way, what earnest care it worked in you. Yes, what defense, indignation, fear, longing, zeal, and vindication! In everything you demonstrated yourselves to be pure in the matter.

7.zh: 我虽然从前写信给你们，却不是为那亏负人的，也不是为那受人亏负的，乃要在　神面前把你们顾念我们的热心表明出来。
7.en: So although I wrote to you, I wrote not for his cause that did the wrong, nor for his cause that suffered the wrong, but that your earnest care for us might be revealed in you in the sight of God.

7.zh: 故此，我们得了安慰。 并且在安慰之中，因你们众人使提多心里畅快欢喜，我们就更加欢喜了。
7.en: Therefore we have been comforted. In our comfort we rejoiced the more exceedingly for the joy of Titus, because his spirit has been refreshed by you all.

7.zh: 我若对提多夸奖了你们什么，也觉得没有惭愧；因我对提多夸奖你们的话成了真的，正如我对你们所说的话也都是真的。
7.en: For if in anything I have boasted to him on your behalf, I was not disappointed. But as we spoke all things to you in truth, so our glorying also which I made before Titus was found to be truth.

7.zh: 并且提多想起你们众人的顺服，是怎样恐惧战兢地接待他，他爱你们的心肠就越发热了。
7.en: His affection is more abundantly toward you, while he remembers all of your obedience, how with fear and trembling you received him.

7.zh: 我如今欢喜，能在凡事上为你们放心。
7.en: I rejoice that in everything I am confident concerning you.

8.zh: 弟兄们，我把　神赐给马其顿众教会的恩告诉你们，
8.en: Moreover, brothers, we make known to you the grace of God which has been given in the assemblies of Macedonia,

8.zh: 就是他们在患难中受大试炼的时候，仍有满足的快乐，在极穷之间还格外显出他们乐捐的厚恩。
8.en: how in a severe ordeal of affliction, the abundance of their joy and their deep poverty abounded to the riches of their generosity.

8.zh: 我可以证明，他们是按着力量，而且也过了力量，自己甘心乐意地捐助，
8.en: For according to their power, I testify, yes and beyond their power, they gave of their own accord,

8.zh: 再三地求我们，准他们在这供给圣徒的恩情上有分；
8.en: begging us with much entreaty to receive this grace and the fellowship in the service to the saints.

8.zh: 并且他们所做的，不但照我们所想望的，更照　神的旨意先把自己献给主，又归附了我们。
8.en: This was not as we had expected, but first they gave their own selves to the Lord, and to us through the will of God.

8.zh: 因此我劝提多，既然在你们中间开办这慈惠的事，就当办成了。
8.en: So we urged Titus, that as he had made a beginning before, so he would also complete in you this grace.

8.zh: 你们既然在信心、口才、知识、热心，和待我们的爱心上，都格外显出满足来，就当在这慈惠的事上也格外显出满足来。
8.en: But as you abound in everything—in faith, utterance, knowledge, all earnestness, and in your love to us—see that you also abound in this grace.

8.zh: 我说这话，不是吩咐你们，乃是借着别人的热心试验你们爱心的实在。
8.en: I speak not by way of commandment, but as proving through the earnestness of others the sincerity also of your love.

8.zh: 你们知道我们主耶稣基督的恩典：他本来富足，却为你们成了贫穷，叫你们因他的贫穷，可以成为富足。
8.en: For you know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, that you through his poverty might become rich.

8.zh: 我在这事上把我的意见告诉你们，是与你们有益；因为你们下手办这事，而且起此心意，已经有一年了，
8.en: I give advice in this: it is expedient for you who were the first to start a year ago, not only to do, but also to be willing.

8.zh: 如今就当办成这事。既有愿做的心，也当照你们所有的去办成。
8.en: But now complete the doing also, that as there was the readiness to be willing, so there may be the completion also out of your ability.

8.zh: 因为人若有愿做的心，必蒙悦纳，乃是照他所有的，并不是照他所无的。
8.en: For if the readiness is there, it is acceptable according to what you have, not according to what you don’t have.

8.zh: 我原不是要别人轻省，你们受累，
8.en: For this is not that others may be eased and you distressed,

8.zh: 乃要均平，就是要你们的富余，现在[可以补]他们的不足，使他们的富余，[将来]也可以[补]你们的不足，这就均平了。
8.en: but for equality. Your abundance at this present time supplies their lack, that their abundance also may become a supply for your lack, that there may be equality.

8.zh: 如[经上]所记： 多[收]的也没有余； 少[收]的也没有缺。
8.en: As it is written, “He who gathered much had nothing left over, and he who gathered little had no lack.”

8.zh: 多谢　神，感动提多的心，叫他待你们殷勤，像我一样。
8.en: But thanks be to God, who puts the same earnest care for you into the heart of Titus.

8.zh: 他固然是听了我的劝，但自己更是热心，情愿往你们那里去。
8.en: For he indeed accepted our exhortation, but being himself very earnest, he went out to you of his own accord.

8.zh: 我们还打发一位兄弟和他同去，这人在福音上得了众教会的称赞。
8.en: We have sent together with him the brother whose praise in the Good News is known throughout all the assemblies.

8.zh: 不但这样，他也被众教会挑选，和我们同行，把所托与我们的这捐资送到了，可以荣耀主，又表明我们乐意的心。
8.en: Not only so, but he was also appointed by the assemblies to travel with us in this grace, which is served by us to the glory of the Lord himself, and to show our readiness.

8.zh: 这就免得有人因我们收的捐银很多，就挑我们的不是。
8.en: We are avoiding this, that any man should blame us concerning this abundance which is administered by us.

8.zh: 我们留心行光明的事，不但在主面前，就在人面前也是这样。
8.en: Having regard for honorable things, not only in the sight of the Lord, but also in the sight of men.

8.zh: 我们又打发一位兄弟同去；这人的热心，我们在许多事上屡次试验过。现在他因为深信你们，就更加热心了。
8.en: We have sent with them our brother whom we have many times proved earnest in many things, but now much more earnest, by reason of the great confidence which he has in you.

8.zh: 论到提多，他是我的同伴，一同为你们劳碌的。论到那两位兄弟，他们是众教会的使者，是基督的荣耀。
8.en: As for Titus, he is my partner and fellow worker for you. As for our brothers, they are the apostles of the assemblies, the glory of Christ.

8.zh: 所以，你们务要在众教会面前显明你们爱心的凭据，并我所夸奖你们的凭据。
8.en: Therefore show the proof of your love to them before the assemblies, and of our boasting on your behalf.

9.zh: 论到供给圣徒的事，我不必写信给你们；
9.en: It is indeed unnecessary for me to write to you concerning the service to the saints,

9.zh: 因为我知道你们乐意的心，常对马其顿人夸奖你们，说亚该亚人预备好了，已经有一年了；并且你们的热心激动了许多人。
9.en: for I know your readiness, of which I boast on your behalf to those of Macedonia, that Achaia has been prepared for the past year. Your zeal has stirred up very many of them.

9.zh: 但我打发那几位弟兄去，要叫你们照我的话预备妥当，免得我们在这事上夸奖你们的话落了空。
9.en: But I have sent the brothers so that our boasting on your behalf may not be in vain in this respect, that, just as I said, you may be prepared,

9.zh: 万一有马其顿人与我同去，见你们没有预备，就叫我们所确信的，反成了羞愧；你们羞愧，更不用说了。
9.en: lest by any means, if anyone from Macedonia comes there with me and finds you unprepared, we (to say nothing of you) would be disappointed in this confident boasting.

9.zh: 因此，我想不得不求那几位弟兄先到你们那里去，把从前所应许的捐资预备妥当，就显出你们所捐的是出于乐意，不是出于勉强。
9.en: I thought it necessary therefore to entreat the brothers that they would go before to you and arrange ahead of time the generous gift that you promised before, that the same might be ready as a matter of generosity, and not of greediness.

9.zh: 「少种的少收，多种的多收」，这话是真的。
9.en: Remember this: he who sows sparingly will also reap sparingly. He who sows bountifully will also reap bountifully.

9.zh: 各人要随本心所酌定的，不要作难，不要勉强，因为捐得乐意的人是　神所喜爱的。
9.en: Let each man give according as he has determined in his heart, not grudgingly or under compulsion, for God loves a cheerful giver.

9.zh: 神能将各样的恩惠多多地加给你们，使你们凡事常常充足，能多行各样善事。
9.en: And God is able to make all grace abound to you, that you, always having all sufficiency in everything, may abound to every good work.

9.zh: 如[经上]所记： 他施舍[钱财]，周济贫穷； 他的仁义存到永远。
9.en: As it is written, “He has scattered abroad. He has given to the poor. His righteousness remains forever.”

9.zh: 那赐种给撒种的，赐粮给人吃的，必多多加给你们种地的种子，又增添你们仁义的果子；
9.en: Now may he who supplies seed to the sower and bread for food, supply and multiply your seed for sowing, and increase the fruits of your righteousness,

9.zh: 叫你们凡事富足，可以多多施舍，就借着我们使感谢归于　神。
9.en: you being enriched in everything for all generosity, which produces thanksgiving to God through us.

9.zh: 因为办这供给的事，不但补圣徒的缺乏，而且叫许多人越发感谢　神。
9.en: For this service of giving that you perform not only makes up for lack among the saints, but abounds also through much giving of thanks to God,

9.zh: 他们从这供给的事上得了凭据，知道你们承认基督顺服他的福音，多多地捐钱给他们和众人，便将荣耀归与　神。
9.en: seeing that through the proof given by this service, they glorify God for the obedience of your confession to the Good News of Christ and for the generosity of your contribution to them and to all,

9.zh: 他们也因　神极大的恩赐显在你们心里，就切切地想念你们，为你们祈祷。
9.en: while they themselves also, with supplication on your behalf, yearn for you by reason of the exceeding grace of God in you.

9.zh: 感谢　神，因他有说不尽的恩赐！
9.en: Now thanks be to God for his unspeakable gift!

10.zh: 我—保罗，就是与你们见面的时候是谦卑的，不在你们那里的时候向你们是勇敢的，如今亲自借着基督的温柔、和平劝你们。
10.en: Now I Paul, myself, entreat you by the humility and gentleness of Christ, I who in your presence am lowly among you, but being absent am bold toward you.

10.zh: 有人以为我是凭着血气行事，我也以为必须用勇敢待这等人；求你们不要叫我在你们那里的时候，有这样的勇敢。
10.en: Yes, I beg you that I may not, when present, show courage with the confidence with which I intend to be bold against some, who consider us to be walking according to the flesh.

10.zh: 因为我们虽然在血气中行事，却不凭着血气争战。
10.en: For though we walk in the flesh, we don’t wage war according to the flesh;

10.zh: 我们争战的兵器本不是属血气的，乃是在　神面前有能力，可以攻破坚固的营垒，
10.en: for the weapons of our warfare are not of the flesh, but mighty before God to the throwing down of strongholds,

10.zh: 将各样的计谋，各样拦阻人认识　神的那些自高之事，一概攻破了，又将人所有的心意夺回，使他都顺服基督。
10.en: throwing down imaginations and every high thing that is exalted against the knowledge of God and bringing every thought into captivity to the obedience of Christ,

10.zh: 并且我已经预备好了，等你们十分顺服的时候，要责罚那一切不顺服的人。
10.en: and being in readiness to avenge all disobedience when your obedience is made full.

10.zh: 你们是看眼前的吗？倘若有人自信是属基督的，他要再想想，他如何属基督，我们也是如何属基督的。
10.en: Do you look at things only as they appear in front of your face? If anyone trusts in himself that he is Christ’s, let him consider this again with himself, that even as he is Christ’s, so we also are Christ’s.

10.zh: 主赐给我们权柄，是要造就你们，并不是要败坏你们；我就是为这权柄稍微夸口，也不至于惭愧。
10.en: For even if I boast somewhat abundantly concerning our authority, which the Lord gave for building you up and not for casting you down, I will not be ashamed,

10.zh: 我[说这话]，免得你们以为我写信是要威吓你们；
10.en: that I may not seem as if I desire to terrify you by my letters.

10.zh: 因为有人说：「他的信又沉重又厉害，及至见面，却是气貌不扬，言语粗俗的。」
10.en: For, “His letters”, they say, “are weighty and strong, but his bodily presence is weak, and his speech is despised.”

10.zh: 这等人当想，我们不在那里的时候，信上的言语如何，见面的时候，行事也必如何。
10.en: Let such a person consider this, that what we are in word by letters when we are absent, such are we also in deed when we are present.

10.zh: 因为我们不敢将自己和那自荐的人同列相比。他们用自己度量自己，用自己比较自己，乃是不通达的。
10.en: For we are not bold to number or compare ourselves with some of those who commend themselves. But they themselves, measuring themselves by themselves, and comparing themselves with themselves, are without understanding.

10.zh: 我们不愿意分外夸口，只要照　神所量给我们的界限搆到你们那里。
10.en: But we will not boast beyond proper limits, but within the boundaries with which God appointed to us, which reach even to you.

10.zh: 我们并非过了自己的界限，好像搆不到你们那里；因为我们早到你们那里，传了基督的福音。
10.en: For we don’t stretch ourselves too much, as though we didn’t reach to you. For we came even as far as to you with the Good News of Christ,

10.zh: 我们不仗着别人所劳碌的，分外夸口；但指望你们信心增长的时候，所量给我们的界限，就可以因着你们更加开展，
10.en: not boasting beyond proper limits in other men’s labors, but having hope that as your faith grows, we will be abundantly enlarged by you in our sphere of influence,

10.zh: 得以将福音传到你们以外的地方；并不是在别人界限之内，借着他现成的事夸口。
10.en: so as to preach the Good News even to the parts beyond you, not to boast in what someone else has already done.

10.zh: 但夸口的，当指着主夸口。
10.en: But “he who boasts, let him boast in the Lord.”

10.zh: 因为蒙悦纳的，不是自己称许的，乃是主所称许的。
10.en: For it isn’t he who commends himself who is approved, but whom the Lord commends.

11.zh: 但愿你们宽容我这一点愚妄，其实你们原是宽容我的。
11.en: I wish that you would bear with me in a little foolishness, but indeed you do bear with me.

11.zh: 我为你们起的愤恨，原是　神那样的愤恨。因为我曾把你们许配一个丈夫，要把你们如同贞洁的童女，献给基督。
11.en: For I am jealous over you with a godly jealousy. For I promised you in marriage to one husband, that I might present you as a pure virgin to Christ.

11.zh: 我只怕你们的心或偏于邪，失去那向基督所存纯一清洁的心，就像蛇用诡诈诱惑了夏娃一样。
11.en: But I am afraid that somehow, as the serpent deceived Eve in his craftiness, so your minds might be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Christ.

11.zh: 假如有人来另传一个耶稣，不是我们所传过的；或者你们另受一个灵，不是你们所受过的；或者另得一个福音，不是你们所得过的；你们容让他也就罢了。
11.en: For if he who comes preaches another Jesus whom we didn’t preach, or if you receive a different spirit which you didn’t receive, or a different “good news” which you didn’t accept, you put up with that well enough.

11.zh: 但我想，我一点不在那些最大的使徒以下。
11.en: For I reckon that I am not at all behind the very best apostles.

11.zh: 我的言语虽然粗俗，我的知识却不粗俗。这是我们在凡事上向你们众人显明出来的。
11.en: But though I am unskilled in speech, yet I am not unskilled in knowledge. No, in every way we have been revealed to you in all things.

11.zh: 我因为白白传　神的福音给你们，就自居卑微，叫你们高升，这算是我犯罪吗？
11.en: Or did I commit a sin in humbling myself that you might be exalted, because I preached to you God’s Good News free of charge?

11.zh: 我亏负了别的教会，向他们取了工价来给你们效力。
11.en: I robbed other assemblies, taking wages from them that I might serve you.

11.zh: 我在你们那里缺乏的时候，并没有累着你们一个人；因我所缺乏的，那从马其顿来的弟兄们都补足了。我向来凡事谨守，后来也必谨守，总不至于累着你们。
11.en: When I was present with you and was in need, I wasn’t a burden on anyone, for the brothers, when they came from Macedonia, supplied the measure of my need. In everything I kept myself from being burdensome to you, and I will continue to do so.

11.zh: 既有基督的诚实在我里面，就无人能在亚该亚一带地方阻挡我这自夸。
11.en: As the truth of Christ is in me, no one will stop me from this boasting in the regions of Achaia.

11.zh: 为什么呢？是因我不爱你们吗？这有　神知道。
11.en: Why? Because I don’t love you? God knows.

11.zh: 我现在所做的，后来还要做，为要断绝那些寻机会人的机会，使他们在所夸的事上也不过与我们一样。
11.en: But what I do, that I will continue to do, that I may cut off opportunity from those who desire an opportunity, that in which they boast, they may be recognized just like us.

11.zh: 那等人是假使徒，行事诡诈，装作基督使徒的模样。
11.en: For such men are false apostles, deceitful workers, masquerading as Christ’s apostles.

11.zh: 这也不足为怪，因为连撒但也装作光明的天使。
11.en: And no wonder, for even Satan masquerades as an angel of light.

11.zh: 所以他的差役，若装作仁义的差役，也不算希奇。他们的结局必然照着他们的行为。
11.en: It is no great thing therefore if his servants also masquerade as servants of righteousness, whose end will be according to their works.

11.zh: 我再说，人不可把我看作愚妄的。纵然如此，也要把我当作愚妄人接纳，叫我可以略略自夸。
11.en: I say again, let no one think me foolish. But if so, yet receive me as foolish, that I also may boast a little.

11.zh: 我说的话不是奉主命说的，乃是像愚妄人放胆自夸；
11.en: That which I speak, I don’t speak according to the Lord, but as in foolishness, in this confidence of boasting.

11.zh: 既有好些人凭着血气自夸，我也要自夸了。
11.en: Seeing that many boast after the flesh, I will also boast.

11.zh: 你们既是精明人，就能甘心忍耐愚妄人。
11.en: For you bear with the foolish gladly, being wise.

11.zh: 假若有人强你们作奴仆，或侵吞你们，或掳掠你们，或侮慢你们，或打你们的脸，你们都能忍耐他。
11.en: For you bear with a man if he brings you into bondage, if he devours you, if he takes you captive, if he exalts himself, or if he strikes you on the face.

11.zh: 我说这话是羞辱自己，好像我们从前是软弱的。然而，人在何事上勇敢，（我说句愚妄话，）我也勇敢。
11.en: To my shame, I speak as though we had been weak. Yet in whatever way anyone is bold (I speak in foolishness), I am bold also.

11.zh: 他们是希伯来人吗？我也是。他们是以色列人吗？我也是。他们是亚伯拉罕的后裔吗？我也是。
11.en: Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Israelites? So am I. Are they the offspring of Abraham? So am I.

11.zh: 他们是基督的仆人吗？（我说句狂话，）我更是。我比他们多受劳苦，多下监牢，受鞭打是过重的，冒死是屡次有的。
11.en: Are they servants of Christ? (I speak as one beside himself.) I am more so: in labors more abundantly, in prisons more abundantly, in stripes above measure, and in deaths often.

11.zh: 被犹太人鞭打五次，每次四十减去一下；
11.en: Five times I received forty stripes minus one from the Jews.

11.zh: 被棍打了三次；被石头打了一次；遇着船坏三次，一昼一夜在深海里。
11.en: Three times I was beaten with rods. Once I was stoned. Three times I suffered shipwreck. I have been a night and a day in the deep.

11.zh: 又屡次行远路，遭江河的危险、盗贼的危险、同族的危险、外邦人的危险、城里的危险、旷野的危险、海中的危险、假弟兄的危险。
11.en: I have been in travels often, perils of rivers, perils of robbers, perils from my countrymen, perils from the Gentiles, perils in the city, perils in the wilderness, perils in the sea, perils among false brothers;

11.zh: 受劳碌、受困苦，多次不得睡，又饥又渴，多次不得食，受寒冷，赤身露体。
11.en: in labor and travail, in watchings often, in hunger and thirst, in fastings often, and in cold and nakedness.

11.zh: 除了这外面的事，还有为众教会挂心的事，天天压在我身上。
11.en: Besides those things that are outside, there is that which presses on me daily: anxiety for all the assemblies.

11.zh: 有谁软弱，我不软弱呢？有谁跌倒，我不焦急呢？
11.en: Who is weak, and I am not weak? Who is caused to stumble, and I don’t burn with indignation?

11.zh: 我若必须自夸，就夸那关乎我软弱的事便了。
11.en: If I must boast, I will boast of the things that concern my weakness.

11.zh: 那永远可称颂之主耶稣的父　神知道我不说谎。
11.en: The God and Father of the Lord Jesus Christ, he who is blessed forever more, knows that I don’t lie.

11.zh: 在大马士革的亚哩达王手下的提督把守大马士革城，要捉拿我，
11.en: In Damascus the governor under King Aretas guarded the Damascenes’ city, desiring to arrest me.

11.zh: 我就从窗户中，在筐子里，从城墙上被人缒下去，脱离了他的手。
11.en: I was let down in a basket through a window by the wall, and escaped his hands.

12.zh: 我自夸固然无益，但我是不得已的。如今我要说到主的显现和启示。
12.en: It is doubtless not profitable for me to boast, but I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord.

12.zh: 我认得一个在基督里的人，他前十四年被提到第三层天上去；（或在身内，我不知道；或在身外，我也不知道；只有　神知道。）
12.en: I know a man in Christ who was caught up into the third heaven fourteen years ago—whether in the body, I don’t know, or whether out of the body, I don’t know; God knows.

12.zh: 我认得这人；（或在身内，或在身外，我都不知道，只有　神知道。）
12.en: I know such a man (whether in the body, or outside of the body, I don’t know; God knows),

12.zh: 他被提到乐园里，听见隐秘的言语，是人不可说的。
12.en: how he was caught up into Paradise and heard unspeakable words, which it is not lawful for a man to utter.

12.zh: 为这人，我要夸口；但是为我自己，除了[我的]软弱以外，我并不夸口。
12.en: On behalf of such a one I will boast, but on my own behalf I will not boast, except in my weaknesses.

12.zh: 我就是愿意夸口也不算狂，因为我必说实话；只是我禁止不说，恐怕有人把我看高了，过于他在我身上所看见所听见的。
12.en: For if I would desire to boast, I will not be foolish; for I will speak the truth. But I refrain, so that no man may think more of me than that which he sees in me or hears from me.

12.zh: 又恐怕我因所得的启示甚大，就过于自高，所以有一根刺加在我肉体上，就是撒但的差役要攻击我，免得我过于自高。
12.en: By reason of the exceeding greatness of the revelations, that I should not be exalted excessively, a thorn in the flesh was given to me: a messenger of Satan to torment me, that I should not be exalted excessively.

12.zh: 为这事，我三次求过主，叫这刺离开我。
12.en: Concerning this thing, I begged the Lord three times that it might depart from me.

12.zh: 他对我说：「我的恩典够你用的，因为我的能力是在人的软弱上显得完全。」所以，我更喜欢夸自己的软弱，好叫基督的能力覆庇我。
12.en: He has said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.” Most gladly therefore I will rather glory in my weaknesses, that the power of Christ may rest on me.

12.zh: 我为基督的缘故，就以软弱、凌辱、急难、逼迫、困苦为可喜乐的；因我什么时候软弱，什么时候就刚强了。
12.en: Therefore I take pleasure in weaknesses, in injuries, in necessities, in persecutions, and in distresses, for Christ’s sake. For when I am weak, then am I strong.

12.zh: 我成了愚妄人，是被你们强逼的。我本该被你们称许才是。我虽算不了什么，却没有一件事在那些最大的使徒以下。
12.en: I have become foolish in boasting. You compelled me, for I ought to have been commended by you, for I am in no way inferior to the very best apostles, though I am nothing.

12.zh: 我在你们中间，用百般的忍耐，借着神迹、奇事、异能显出使徒的凭据来。
12.en: Truly the signs of an apostle were worked among you in all perseverance, in signs and wonders and mighty works.

12.zh: 除了我不累着你们这一件事，你们还有什么事不及别的教会呢？这不公之处，求你们饶恕我吧。
12.en: For what is there in which you were made inferior to the rest of the assemblies, unless it is that I myself was not a burden to you? Forgive me this wrong!

12.zh: 如今，我打算第三次到你们那里去，也必不累着你们；因我所求的是你们，不是你们的[财物]。儿女不该为父母积财，父母该为儿女积财。
12.en: Behold, this is the third time I am ready to come to you, and I will not be a burden to you; for I seek not your possessions, but you. For the children ought not to save up for the parents, but the parents for the children.

12.zh: 我也甘心乐意为你们的灵魂费财费力。难道我越发爱你们，就越发少得你们的爱吗？
12.en: I will most gladly spend and be spent for your souls. If I love you more abundantly, am I loved the less?

12.zh: 罢了，我自己并没有累着你们，[你们却有人说]，我是诡诈，用心计牢笼你们。
12.en: Even so, I myself didn’t burden you. But you might say that being crafty, I caught you with deception.

12.zh: 我所差到你们那里去的人，我借着他们一个人占过你们的便宜吗？
12.en: Did I take advantage of you by anyone of those whom I have sent to you?

12.zh: 我劝了提多[到你们那里去]，又差那位兄弟与他同去。提多占过你们的便宜吗？我们行事，不同是一个心灵吗？不同是一个脚踪吗？
12.en: I exhorted Titus, and I sent the brother with him. Did Titus take any advantage of you? Didn’t we walk in the same spirit? Didn’t we walk in the same steps?

12.zh: 你们到如今，还想我们是向你们分诉；我们本是在基督里当　神面前说话。亲爱的[弟兄]啊，一切的事都是为造就你们。
12.en: Again, do you think that we are excusing ourselves to you? In the sight of God we speak in Christ. But all things, beloved, are for your edifying.

12.zh: 我怕我再来的时候，见你们不合我所想望的，你们见我也不合你们所想望的；又怕有纷争、嫉妒、恼怒、结党、毁谤、谗言、狂傲、混乱的事。
12.en: For I am afraid that perhaps when I come, I might find you not the way I want to, and that I might be found by you as you don’t desire, that perhaps there would be strife, jealousy, outbursts of anger, factions, slander, whisperings, proud thoughts, or riots,

12.zh: 且怕我来的时候，我的　神叫我在你们面前惭愧，又因许多人从前犯罪，行污秽、奸淫、邪荡的事不肯悔改，我就忧愁。
12.en: that again when I come my God would humble me before you, and I would mourn for many of those who have sinned before now, and not repented of the uncleanness, sexual immorality, and lustfulness which they committed.

13.zh: 这是我第三次要到你们那里去。「凭两三个人的口作见证，句句都要定准。」
13.en: This is the third time I am coming to you. “At the mouth of two or three witnesses shall every word be established.”

13.zh: 我从前说过，如今不在你们那里又说，正如我第二次见你们的时候所说的一样，就是对那犯了罪的和其余的人说：「我若再来，必不宽容。」
13.en: I have warned previously, and I warn again, as when I was present the second time, so now, being absent, I write to those who have sinned before now and to all the rest that if I come again, I will not spare,

13.zh: 你们既然寻求基督在我里面说话的凭据，[我必不宽容]。因为，基督在你们身上不是软弱的，在你们里面是有大能的。
13.en: seeing that you seek a proof of Christ who speaks in me who is not weak, but is powerful in you.

13.zh: 他因软弱被钉在十字架上，却因　神的大能仍然活着。我们也是这样同他软弱，但因　神向你们所显的大能，也必与他同活。
13.en: For he was crucified through weakness, yet he lives through the power of God. For we also are weak in him, but we will live with him through the power of God toward you.

13.zh: 你们总要自己省察有信心没有，也要自己试验。岂不知你们若不是可弃绝的，就有耶稣基督在你们心里吗？
13.en: Examine your own selves, whether you are in the faith. Test your own selves. Or don’t you know about your own selves, that Jesus Christ is in you?—unless indeed you are disqualified.

13.zh: 我却盼望你们晓得，我们不是可弃绝的人。
13.en: But I hope that you will know that we aren’t disqualified.

13.zh: 我们求　神，叫你们一件恶事都不做；这不是要显明我们是蒙悦纳的，是要你们行事端正，任凭人看我们是被弃绝的吧！
13.en: Now I pray to God that you do no evil; not that we may appear approved, but that you may do that which is honorable, though we may seem to have failed.

13.zh: 我们凡事不能敌挡真理，只能扶助真理。
13.en: For we can do nothing against the truth, but for the truth.

13.zh: 即便我们软弱，你们刚强，我们也欢喜；并且我们所求的，就是你们作完全人。
13.en: For we rejoice when we are weak and you are strong. We also pray for this: your becoming perfect.

13.zh: 所以，我不在你们那里的时候，把这话写给你们，好叫我见你们的时候，不用照主所给我的权柄严厉地待你们。这权柄原是为造就人，并不是为败坏人。
13.en: For this cause I write these things while absent, that I may not deal sharply when present, according to the authority which the Lord gave me for building up and not for tearing down.

13.zh: 还有末了的话：愿弟兄们都喜乐。要作完全人；要受安慰；要同心合意；要彼此和睦。如此，仁爱和平的　神必常与你们同在。
13.en: Finally, brothers, rejoice! Be perfected. Be comforted. Be of the same mind. Live in peace, and the God of love and peace will be with you.

13.zh: 你们亲嘴问安，彼此务要圣洁。
13.en: Greet one another with a holy kiss.

13.zh: 愿主耶稣基督的恩惠、　神的慈爱、圣灵的感动[常]与你们众人同在！
13.en: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, God’s love, and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit be with you all. Amen.
